Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_Other: TWA 8. Coat, pour, sew, drill, carve
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_EnableMinigame_tool: Play a minigame for every crafting procedure and score it Miss/Bad/Good/Excellent. When off, every procedure runs as a plain progress bar and always scores Excellent.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_MinigameSounds_tool: Play the procedure's working sound while you work in a minigame (hammer blows, the whetstone, the saw, the torch...).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_CraftButtonSeconds_: How long the Start action takes, in real seconds.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_EndButtonSeconds_to: How long the Finish, Incomplete and Cancel actions take, in real seconds (round 17: 40 percent shorter than Start).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ProcedureSeconds_to: How long the time bar after a procedure's minigame takes, in real seconds (every procedure).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_NearbyRadius_toolti: Tools, materials and base items are also found in containers and on the floor this many tiles around you. 0 = only what you carry.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ProcedureXPMultipli: Multiplies the skill XP a finished procedure gives (base: 5 x the procedure's skill level). 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_RequireLight_toolti: A procedure can't be done where it is too dark to read.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_RequireForge_toolti: Forging procedures need a forge of the right level nearby. Off: they can be done anywhere.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ForgeSearchRadius_t: How many tiles around you a forge is looked for.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_MissUsesMaterials_t: A procedure scored Miss still uses up its materials (it is not counted as done either way).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_IncompleteZeroDamag: An item left Incomplete (or with the window closed) has its damage set to 0 until the craft is finished.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ActionSounds_toolti: Working sounds while a procedure's time bar or Start/Cancel/Incomplete/Finish runs.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GradeReveal_tooltip: After Finish, a short show: the hammer on the anvil until the rolled grade appears (for the Gemstone recipe: the stone cracking open while the roll spins).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_AllowWeaponDebug_to: Admins, and anyone running with -debug, can right-click a weapon to edit every stat it has. Off: the menu never appears.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_DamageDisplayScale_: Damage, DPS and zombie HP are SHOWN multiplied by this (100: a 0.8 hit reads 80). Only the display: the game computes with its own values.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ShareDamageNumbers_: Multiplayer: the damage numbers of your hits also show for players near you.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_DamageNumberRange_t: How near a player must be to see someone else's damage numbers.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_BadBelow_tooltip: The procedures' average score (Bad=1, Good=2, Excellent=3) below this is an overall Bad.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GoodBelow_tooltip: An average below this (and not Bad) is Good; at or above it, Excellent.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GradeChance1_toolti: Pools: Excellent S/A/B, Good B/C/D, Bad D/E/F. Chance weight of the pool's 1st grade.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GradeChance2_toolti: Chance weight of the pool's 2nd grade.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GradeChance3_toolti: Chance weight of the pool's 3rd grade. The three weights need not add up to 100.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_MaterialNeedsGood: Materials need Good or better to finish
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_MaterialNeedsGood_t: Material recipes can only be finished at an overall quality of Good or Excellent.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemChanceExcellent_: Finishing the Gemstone recipe rolls what the stone held: at an overall Excellent, this percent gives a gem (every gem equal, the diamond the rarest); the rest gives clay, scrap metal, limestone, charcoal, coke, iron/gold/silver/copper/aluminum scrap or dung.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemChanceGood_toolt: The same at an overall Good.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemChanceBad_toolti: The same at an overall Bad.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemDiamondShare: Gemstone: diamond's share of the gem chance (percent)
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemDiamondShare_too: Of the gem chance above, the diamond gets this percent; the other gems share the rest equally. Default 4: at Good (25) the diamond is 1 percent of all rolls, at Excellent (50) 2 percent.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemBreakBad: Gem refining: break chance at Bad (percent)
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemBreakBad_tooltip: Finishing a gem-refining recipe (Refined to Pure) at an overall Bad breaks the gem this often; it is lost.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemBreakGood: Gem refining: break chance at Good (percent)
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemBreakGood_toolti: The same at an overall Good.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemBreakExcellent: Gem refining: break chance at Excellent (percent)
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GemBreakExcellent_t: The same at an overall Excellent.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_MinigameExcellentAt: The quality meter left at the end (0-1) from which a minigame scores Excellent.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_MinigameGoodAt_tool: From this (and below Excellent) a minigame scores Good; below it, Bad.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_QualityDrain_toolti: Multiplies how much quality every mistake costs in every minigame.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_QualityZeroIsMiss_t: When the quality meter hits 0 the minigame ends at once as a Miss.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ZoneSize_tooltip: Makes every zone, band and allowance in every minigame bigger (>1) or smaller (<1).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GameSpeed_tooltip: Makes the moving parts of every minigame faster (>1) or slower (<1).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_HandLagMs_tooltip: How far the tool trails the mouse. 0 = none.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_Tremor_tooltip: Pain, panic and drunkenness make the tool shake.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SkillZonePerLevel: Zone bonus per skill level above need
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SkillZonePerLevel_t: Each skill level above what the procedure needs widens the zones by this much (0.06 = 6 percent).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SkillZoneMax_toolti: The skill zone bonus never goes above this multiplier.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SpeedPerNeededLevel: Harder procedures (higher needed level) run this much faster per level.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_StrikeRingSize_tool: Radius (px) the timing ring starts at.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_StrikeRingMs_toolti: How long the ring takes to close. Lower = faster.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_StrikeWindowMs_tool: How early/late a blow may land and still count (perfect is 45 percent of it).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_StrikeMarkSize_tool: Radius (px) of the lit mark the hammer must land on.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SmashOneBlow_toolti: Smashing (a bottle) is done in one timed blow.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ForgeCool1_tooltip: Hot-to-cold time on the first forging procedure (Forge Shape). Lower = cools faster.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ForgeReheatMs_toolt: How long holding on the coals takes to bring the bar from cold to full heat.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SharpenStrokes_tool: How many counted flicks sharpening needs.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_PolishStrokes_toolt: How many counted flicks polishing needs.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_FlickMinSpeed_toolt: Average speed (px/ms) a sharpening/polishing flick needs to count. Slower costs quality.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_WeldZigzag_tooltip: The weld follows a zig-zag weave. Off: a straight seam.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_WeldMaxSpeed_toolti: Faster than this (px/ms) leaves gaps and costs quality.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_WeldBurnSpeed_toolt: Slower than this (px/ms) burns through and costs quality. 0 = never burns.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_WrapZone_tooltip: Half-width of the circle zone for wrapping, screwing and drilling.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ClothZoneMultiplier: Extra multiplier on the zone for cloth wraps.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_TapeZoneMultiplier_: Extra multiplier on the zone for binding (tape) wraps.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ScrewTurns_tooltip: How many turns tighten a screw/bolt.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ScrewStripAt_toolti: Turning this far past snug strips the thread.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ScrewSnugSlack_tool: Letting go this close under snug still counts.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_GrindMinSpeed_toolt: Turns per second the grindstone needs to bite.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_HeatZone_tooltip: Half-width of the temperature band for fire, melting, annealing and bending (gauge 0-1.2).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_CoolZone_tooltip: Half-width of the band for quenching/cooling.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_CoolDrain_tooltip: Extra multiplier on quality loss while quenching.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_HeatHoldMs_tooltip: How long the needle must be held in the band (plus 300 ms per needed skill level).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_BendHoldMs_tooltip: How long a branch must be held bent before it snaps cleanly.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_HeatOutsideCosts_to: Once the band has been reached, every moment outside it costs quality (also the grindstone).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ZoneDrift_tooltip: The target band drifts slowly back and forth while you work (heat, quench, bend, grindstone, sewing tension, carving depth, pour line).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_CoatCoverage_toolti: Fraction of the surface a coat must cover (0.9 = 90 percent).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_PourZone_tooltip: How close to the fill line the pour must stop.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SutureStitches_tool: Stitches sewing needs, plus one per two needed skill levels.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_SutureZone_tooltip: Half-width of the needle's path zone.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ExtractGuide_toolti: How far the drill bit may lean before it snags.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_ExtractMaxHoles_too: The most holes a drill core can ask for.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_IncisionZone_toolti: Half-width of the cutting line zone.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_TWA_EngraveWideDepth_to: Engraving's depth band covers 90 percent of the gauge. Off: the same narrow band as carving.
